rule.name: ServerOrContainerPerTest
rule.message: Do not start a container, server or process for each test: a non-static @Container field, a @Rule or an instance @RegisterExtension of one, a start in @BeforeEach, @Before or @BeforeMethod (or a method of the class it calls) on an object made for each test, or the same start in two or more tests of a class. Start it once (a static @Container, a @ClassRule, a static @RegisterExtension or @BeforeAll) and reset its state between tests, or test the logic against an in-memory implementation and keep the real transport for transport tests. An exception fits only when each test needs a fresh instance.
